name: morocco-corporate-income-tax
description: Use this skill whenever asked about Morocco company tax (impot sur les societes, IS) for tax year 2026: who pays, the 20%, 35% and 40% rates for years opened from 1 January 2026, the MAD 100 million test, the tax result, the cotisation minimale, four instalments, the three-month return, penalties and non-resident companies. Trigger on phrases like "impot sur les societes Maroc", "IS Maroc", "Morocco corporate tax", "acomptes provisionnels", "cotisation minimale societe". Replies in the user's language.
